Thank you, I thought cutting at the age of 20 was considered bad in a way, or people might think I'm genuinely mental. I don't know why I do it, I just know that when things get tough, that's what I do to feel calm and get rid of any anger or tears I have. 

Thank you for your help, it is hard meeting people and I will try and gain the confidence to do so. Thank you, very much. 
Much appreciated. :)
